detail: spike times must be non-decreasing (searchsorted depends on it)
per-cluster metadata arrays must match n_clusters
every spike must map to an existing cluster
peak channel must index a channel region
clusters with no spikes cannot be analysed
trial field lengths: [214]
intervals must be an (n_trials, 2) array
0 trials with goCue <= stimulus onset
contrasts must come from the task's contrast set
response_choice in {-1, 0, 1}
too few included trials for population analyses would be fatal
positions and times are paired by row and must have equal length
flash times must be strictly non-decreasing after sorting
expected 9 x 33 grid for this stimulus
occupancy must be roughly balanced for an unbiased STA
distinct presentations closer than the STA window cause overlapping responses (simultaneous flashes are allowed)
cell index must be invertible to (x, y) for RF maps
vectorised spike counting must equal a direct boolean count
spike counts must be non-negative integers
sum of binned counts must equal spikes inside the bin range
design stimulus columns must equal the movie at t - lag
GLM target must be the spike counts of the matching bins
history term at row i must equal counts[i + lag - h]
fraction of units called responsive under circular shifting (should be close to the FDR level)
observed accuracy vs the label-permutation null (a scientific result, reported for every session)
permutation test is stricter; a large gap means the Gaussian threshold over-calls significance
median across units of the odd/even correlation of the condition-mean response (reliability of stimulus responses)
median correlation between unit rate and global rate profile across the session (high values indicate state-driven units)
